messages.content: Check only finite one-beat activity completion in the proposed ARC. Ignore every other concern. Return JSON only.

SOURCE STORY
A realistic action film about a woman, Amy, protecting her two kids (Will and Amber) from a zombie apocalypse.
Amy is at home on a normal day, wearing a tight, black tank top and denim jeans, cooking breakfast for her young kids.
Suddenly, a zombie breaks the kitchen door window and Amy sees the danger. She rushes her kids to the basement, gets them inside, and then locks the door.
She retrieves her hidden arsenal consisting of a pistol and a katana. She equips the weapons.
The majority of the film is Amy killing (dismembering, decapitating, etc.) zombies as they try and attack her.
Amy kills the last of the zombies, her house now soaked in blood. She lets her kids out of the basement.

Check exactly one thing:
Does any required_event assign a FINITE source activity wholly to one beat but leave that activity merely in progress instead of reaching its ordinary visible completion?

Rules:
- An explicit extended/repeated process that spans multiple beats is NOT a finite one-beat activity. Ignore its middle continuation beats.
- Do not critique pacing, bundling, detail, source coverage, majority allocation, style, or whether adjacent actions share a beat.
- A multi-action event is allowed if its listed actions reach their stated outcomes.
- Return only the first real finite-activity completion defect.
- If none exists, return VALID.
